name: Hello Window

cmd:
{ echo 'Hello from a V2Mac mini VM.'; echo "Exit IP: $(timeout 10 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/api.ipify.org/80; printf "GET / HTTP/1.0
Host: api.ipify.org

" >&3; tail -n1 <&3')"; echo 'Shared folder:'; ls ~/Shared 2>&1; echo; echo 'Type here; paste with Cmd-V:'; } > /tmp/hello.txt; exec zenity --text-info --editable --title='Hello Window' --width=900 --height=600 --filename=/tmp/hello.txt

securityNotes: Asks for the clipboard and the Shared folder to show both work.
